notes.text: The heading explicitly writes Rav. Hananiah/Santonia and Hanina/Antayah preserve different supplied forms. Santonia (סנתוניא) and Antayah (ענתייה) have uncertain vowels and identification; the target’s abbreviated title remains R'.
